method: Read all 21 dev/model-qa/flip-verdict-sheets/sheet-NN.png sheets cell-by-cell (252 slugs total, cropped per-cell for legibility), judged MATCH/MISMATCH/DUBIOUS/NOT-JUDGEABLE against the legacy art + slug name as the identity reference. For every MISMATCH/DUBIOUS, traced cause via dev/model-qa/faceted-cut-report.json (sourceFile/cellIndex/cellsProvenance), cross-checked sibling cells in the same candidate file for cut-order-swap signatures, and directly opened raw candidate source images (dev/model-qa/faceted-sheets/*/raw-figures/*.png) plus provenance/*-generation-calls.json where sibling evidence was inconclusive.
